'''Omi Shrine''' (おおみじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in Ōaza Nakami, {{ill|Meiwa, Mie|arz|ميوا|ceb|Meiwa-chō|ckb|میێوا (میێ)|es|Meiwa (Mie)|fa|میوا، میئه|fr|Meiwa (Mie)|hy|Մեյվա|id|Meiwa, Mie|it|Meiwa (Mie)|ja|明和町 (三重県)|ko|메이와정 (미에현)|ms|Meiwa, Mie|my|မဲအိဝမြို့၊ မိအဲ|pl|Meiwa|ru|Мейва (Миэ)|sv|Meiwa, Mie|tl|Meiwa, Mie|tr|Meiwa, Mie|uk|Мейва (Міє)|ur|میوا، میے|vi|Meiwa, Mie|zh|明和町 (三重縣)|qid=Q1203258|lt=Meiwa Town}}, {{ill|Taki District, Mie|ceb|Taki-gun|ckb|گەڕەکی تاکی|es|Distrito de Taki|fr|District de Taki|id|Distrik Taki, Mie|it|Distretto di Taki|ja|多気郡|ko|다키군|pl|Powiat Taki (Mie)|uk|Повіт Такі|zh|多氣郡|qid=Q1042360|lt=Taki District}}, {{ill|lt=Mie Prefecture|Mie Prefecture|qid=Q128196}}. It is an {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Engishiki-listed shrine}}; its former {{ill|lt=shrine rank|Shakaku|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|lt=Gōsha|Gō-sha|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== History ===
The date of founding is unknown, but it is identified as one of the Engishiki-listed shrines of {{ill|Ise Province|be|Ісэ (правінцыя)|ckb|پارێزگای ئیسێ|cs|Provincie Ise|de|Provinz Ise|es|Provincia de Ise|eu|Ise probintzia|fa|ولایت ایسه|fi|Isen provinssi|fr|Province d'Ise|gl|Provincia de Ise|hak|Yî-sṳ-koet|id|Provinsi Ise|it|Ise (provincia)|ja|伊勢国|ko|이세국|lt|Isės žemė|nl|Ise (provincie)|pt|Província de Ise|ru|Исэ (провинция)|simple|Ise Province|sk|Ise (provincia)|sr|Провинција Исе|tr|Ise (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ісе|zh|伊勢國|zh_min_nan|Ise-kok|zh_yue|伊勢國|qid=Q864166|lt=Ise Province}}{{ill|Taki District, Mie|ceb|Taki-gun|ckb|گەڕەکی تاکی|es|Distrito de Taki|fr|District de Taki|id|Distrik Taki, Mie|it|Distretto di Taki|ja|多気郡|ko|다키군|pl|Powiat Taki (Mie)|uk|Повіт Такі|zh|多氣郡|qid=Q1042360|lt=Taki District}}. The shrine stands in a rural area spreading north of the {{ill|Ruins of Saikū|el|Σαϊκού|ja|斎宮跡|qid=Q3135853|lt=Saikū Site}}, and nearby flows the {{ill|Harai River|ja|祓川 (三重県)|qid=Q11588499|lt=Haraigawa}}, which served as a place of purification for successive {{ill|Saiō|ca|Saio|de|Saiō|es|Saiō|fa|سایئو|fr|Saiō|hr|Saiō|hu|Szaió|id|Saiō|ja|斎王|min|Saiō|sh|Saiō|sr|Саио|th|ไซโอ|vi|Saiō|zh|齋王|qid=Q19841349|lt=Saiō}}. In {{ill|lt=Meiji|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096}} 45 (1912), six shrines within the village were enshrined together, at which time it came to be called Omi Shrine<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mie Prefectural Association of Shinto Shrines – Omi Shrine|url=http://kyoka.mie-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/%e9%ba%bb%e7%ba%8c%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be/|access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Principal deity: {{ill|lt=Toyokiiri-hiko no Mikoto|Prince Toyokiirihiko|qid=Q11633375}}
* Associated deities: {{ill|Toyosukiiri-hime|fr|Toyosukiiri-hime|ja|豊鍬入姫命|zh|豐鍬入姬命|qid=Q10532771|lt=Toyosukiiri-hime no Mikoto}}; {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993}}; {{ill|lt=Emperor Ōjin|Emperor Ōjin|qid=Q317997}}; {{ill|Ōkuninushi|lt=Ōkuninushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q276944}}; {{ill|Ukanomitama|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Kami}}; {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Toyouke-hime no Kami}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prefectural Association of Shinto Shrines – Omi Shrine|url=https://jinja-net.jp/jinja-all/jsearch3all.php?jinjya=63378|access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref>

=== Rituals ===
* Annual festival: November 3
* Kinen-sai (prayer for a good harvest): February 18
* Niiname-sai (harvest festival): November 23
